properties.displayName: SOC Lab - Defender Antivirus Malware Detection
properties.description: Raises an incident when Microsoft Defender Antivirus on a lab endpoint detects malware (event 1116) or acts on it (event 1117).
properties.query:
Event
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender" and EventID in (1116, 1117)
| extend Threat = extract(@"Name=""Threat Name"">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData),
         Path = extract(@"Name=""Path"">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData),
         Action = extract(@"Name=""Action Name"">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData),
         Severity = extract(@"Name=""Severity Name"">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData)
| summarize Events = count(), EventIDs = make_set(EventID), Actions = make_set(Action),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, Threat, Path, Severity
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, Computer, Threat, Severity, Path, Actions, EventIDs, Events, FirstSeen
